title: Implement Codex discovery and attribution
description:
Implement discovery of Codex rollouts: walk CODEX_HOME (default ~/.codex) sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<timestamp>-<uuid>.jsonl and archived_sessions/**; attribute session from the first session_meta record payload id (fallback: the filename UUID) and project from session_meta payload cwd. Format claims cite the openai/codex rollout source (the CLI is open source).

Done when: discovery finds date-partitioned and archived fixture rollouts, honors CODEX_HOME, and tolerates a missing root.
